intro: I graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science from IISER Bhopal in May 2026, and I currently work as a Project Associate (Junior Research Fellow) under **Prof. Nipun Batra at IIT Gandhinagar**. My work sits at the intersection of **data science, machine learning, and applied statistics**.
focus: Building satellite data extraction pipelines across bands such as NDVI, analyzing the resulting remote sensing data, and developing ML models on top of it to predict crop outcomes.
bullets: Working hands-on with multi-band satellite and remote sensing datasets
Deeply drawn to probability, statistics, mathematics, and numbers
Enjoy experimenting, observing outcomes, and building hypotheses around them
direction: In the long term, I want to transition toward quant or other fields where applied statistics, ML/AI, and mathematical modeling drive the work — leaning on a sharp, rigorous handle on the underlying math.
